_comment: Controls the wikiElections homepage. 'mode': 'active' shows the flashing red breaking-news banner, the LIVE results box, and an RCP-style poll-aggregate donut for activePollsId. 'mode': 'off-cycle' hides the banner and instead shows a scrollable carousel of RCP-style donuts (moderator approval if data/approval-polls.json has entries, otherwise recent-race snapshots). Admins can flip this from /admin/. 'activeElections' lists every race running at once ({pollsId}); the singular activePollsId is kept as a fallback and mirrors the first entry.
